Steam profile backgrounds

Find a background on Steam,
crop it here.

There's no scraped database behind this page - Steam already runs the real, up-to-date one. This links straight to it, shows a small real sample below, and hands off to the Cropper to slice whatever you land on into Featured, Artwork, and Workshop Showcase pieces - auto-hexified so long Workshop artwork actually renders.

How it works

Three steps from "I like this background" to a ready-to-upload showcase set.

1

Find a background

Browse the Points Shop, Market, or your own inventory below - or search the sample gallery further down.

2

Get the image

Copy the image link (right-click → Copy image address), or save it. Steam's background CDN blocks other sites from loading its images directly, so save-and-upload is the reliable path.

3

Crop and export

Open the Cropper, upload or paste the image, hit Export, and get a named, hexified, Steam-ready .zip.

Direct image link from elsewhere (Imgur, Discord, etc.)? The Cropper's "paste a URL" box can skip the save-and-upload step entirely for those hosts - just not Steam's own background CDN, for the CORS reason above.
